verdict.rationale: PayPal's developer hub documents an in-browser API Explorer for testing queries against the Braintree GraphQL API, with an end-to-end example integration. For the core PayPal REST APIs, the evidence shows only browsable OpenAPI descriptions, code generation and import into third-party tools, which is not a first-party interactive, runnable reference. missing for 10: a documented interactive try-it console for the PayPal REST API reference, runnable examples across the main REST APIs (orders, subscriptions, invoicing), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer experience.
